subject: AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF GREECE
text:
U1059/26 NOTAMR U0670/26
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999
A)UUUU B)2608181115 C)2611182359
E)AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF GREECE
STIPULATING THAT ALL RUSSIAN REGISTERED ACFT AND ACFT OWNED,
CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS FROM RUSSIAN
FEDERATION, OR OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC)
ISSUED BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, LAND IN,
TAKE-OFF FROM, OR OVERFLY GREEK NATIONAL AIRSPACE, AS PER NOTAM
A2929/26, AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM
THAT ALL ACFT REGISTERED IN GREECE AND ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR
OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS FROM GREECE, OR OPERATORS
HOLDING AOC ISSUED BY GREECE ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR
OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION, EXC ACFT IN EMERGENCY,
HUM FLT, SAN FLT, AS WELL AS CASES WHEN SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR
FLT OPS GRANTED BY FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR MINISTRY OF
FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE.
